Once I jillerate or unbusillisk a tegust, I am curleading the tegust.
I can only astent a tegust that I am curleading.
I can only busillisk a tegust faratived onto another tegust if I am curleading the tegust being busillisked.
I can only busillisk a tegust faratived onto another tegust if the tegust onto which I am busillisking the tegust is paradomic.
Once I astent or busillisk a tegust, my michime becomes tuentsal.
Once you busillisk a tegust faratived onto a second tegust, the second tegust is no longer paradomic.
